results.name: redisAccessPolicyAssignment
results.reason: Learn selector identifies 2026-09-01 as the latest stable GA; exact current and candidate schemas preserve the required accessPolicyName and user fields and identical constraints for the used literal and nested objectId string.
results.migration: 2026-09-01 GA移行可能。sourceのdefault literalとuser.objectId stringはいずれも候補schemaと互換。

findings.detail: Current 2025-07-01; latest GA 2026-09-01. Exact REST schemas keep required accessPolicyName and user; default satisfies the string pattern and only supported name, and user.objectId remains string. The 2026-09-01 change log removes accessString and provisioningError, neither is used in this Bicep declaration.

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: body:8: Bicep source JSON Pointer /name (expression "name: 'app'"); Bicep child-resource name 'app' becomes the REST accessPolicyAssignmentName path parameter, not request-body JSON.

usage.label: parent
usage.analysis: body:24: Bicep source JSON Pointer /parent (expression 'parent: redisEnterpriseDatabase'); Bicep parent redisEnterpriseDatabase selects the cluster/database path segments of the REST endpoint; it is not an API payload property.

usage.label: properties
usage.analysis: body:62: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties (expression 'properties: {'); Bicep properties is the request-body envelope, not a leaf API field; it contains the required accessPolicyName and user properties.

usage.label: accessPolicyName
usage.analysis: body:86: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties/accessPolicyName (expression "accessPolicyName: 'default'"); Maps to AccessPolicyAssignmentProperties.accessPolicyName (string, regex-constrained); the literal 'default' matches the schema pattern and is the only supported policy name according to the exact current and candidate schemas.

usage.label: user
usage.analysis: body:106: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties/user (expression 'user: {'); Maps to required AccessPolicyAssignmentProperties.user (object); its nested objectId is present. The Bicep object wrapper itself is not a scalar property.

usage.label: objectId
usage.analysis: body:124: Bicep source JSON Pointer /properties/user/objectId (expression 'objectId: principalObjectId'); Maps to AccessPolicyAssignmentProperties.user.objectId (string); principalObjectId is a string-typed Bicep parameter, and the resource condition prevents emission when it is empty.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: header:line:0: Bicep source JSON Pointer /$expression-line/0 (expression "resource redisAccessPolicyAssignment 'Microsoft.Cache/redisEnterprise/databases/accessPolicyAssignments@2025-07-01' = if (!empty(principalObjectId))"); The if (!empty(principalObjectId)) header condition controls resource emission; it is deployment syntax, not serialized request data.

usage.label: $expression
usage.expression: @description('Principal objectId to grant Redis DB access (optional)')
usage.analysis: symbol:principalObjectId:line:0: Bicep source JSON Pointer /$symbol/principalObjectId/$expression-line/0 (expression "@description('Principal objectId to grant Redis DB access (optional)')"); Bicep parameter documentation only, not request data; it documents principalObjectId, the string source for required parent object user.objectId.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: symbol:principalObjectId:line:71: Bicep source JSON Pointer /$symbol/principalObjectId/$expression-line/1 (expression "param principalObjectId string = ''"); Declares principalObjectId as string with empty default; it supplies user.objectId (string), and if (!empty(principalObjectId)) prevents sending an empty value.

current.analysis: Learn current-version page and fixed REST README identify the 2025-07-01 stable contract. Schemas helper expanded AccessPolicyAssignmentProperties: required accessPolicyName (string with pattern) and user (object); user.objectId is string. The declaration supplies both required fields, literal default, and guarded string objectId.

ga.analysis: Learn selector includes GA 2026-09-01 and newer preview 2026-10-01-preview; 2026-09-01 is the newest stable GA. Exact candidate REST model was expanded with Schemas helper; used required fields, accessPolicyName pattern, and user.objectId string match current schema.

breaking.analysis: Learn change log: 2026-09-01 removes accessString and provisioningError from AccessPolicyAssignmentProperties; these are not used in the current Bicep source, and exact 2026-09-01 schema confirms accessPolicyName and user.objectId remain with the same constraints. Current 2025-07-01 change-log entry reports no properties added, updated, or removed.
